fields.id: Integer. Stable, permanent identifier. Never renumbered.
fields.promise: String. Original paraphrase of the promise in the compiler's own words.
fields.reference: String. Scripture citation in 'Book Chapter:Verse' form, NKJV versification.
fields.verse_start: Integer. First verse of the reference range.
fields.verse_end: Integer. Last verse of the range (equals verse_start for single verses).
fields.speaker: String. Primary speaker of the promise (e.g. 'God', 'Angel of the LORD').
fields.speaker_note: String or null. Mediator/qualifier, e.g. 'through Isaiah', 'by oath'.
fields.recipient: String. Who the promise is spoken to or concerns.
fields.categories: Array of strings. Normalized theme tags.
fields.category_raw: String. Original combined theme label as authored (e.g. 'Nation / Kingdom').
fields.conditional: Boolean. true = a human condition is stated in the text.
